authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL haḍḍa explicitly gives Kashmiri aḍa bones, eastern Assamese hār/Bengali hāṛ/Oriya hāṛa and feminine haḍḍī bone in Hindi/Punjabi. The selected eastern aṛa/ar and Adivasi Oriya āḍi/āṛi/aṛi/haṛi/aḍi bone forms are grouped with this regional family, with h loss, rhotic versus stop spelling and final vowels preserved. This does not assert a Kashmiri loan to eastern languages. Regional history remains qualified, and the doubtful asthi comparison is not adopted. Exact response: aṛa.
